board.nothing_how: Pick another day, or today, to see what each companion was working on.
notify.demo: This is the demo. A running console can notify you; this copy has nothing watching a fleet.
notify.how: This browser will be told when a companion starts waiting, even with the page closed.
notify.is_on: This browser is subscribed. Add the page to a home screen to be woken there too.
notify.unsupported: This browser has no push support.
notify.insecure: Only over https or localhost. An ssh tunnel to localhost counts.
notify.denied: This browser was told no. Only its own settings can undo that.
notify.nokey: This console has no push key.
context.no_cache_report: this backend does not report it
empty.no_agents: No magi is running under this config directory.
empty.no_agents_how: Start one with magi --daemon in a workspace.
empty.nothing_learned_how: A rule lands here when you promote something you had to say; a fact lands here when a companion decides one is worth keeping.
empty.nothing_to_promote_how: This fills as you steer a companion mid-turn or refuse a tool — the moments worth turning into a rule.
empty.no_servers_how: A companion can read and run things here; an MCP server is how it reaches anything else.
answer.instead: answering the question above; to ask for something else, answer it or interrupt first
hint.mcp_command: e.g. npx — leave empty for an HTTP server
hint.mcp_args: one per line, or separated by spaces
hint.mcp_url: for an HTTP server, scheme and all
hint.mcp_env: NAME=value — written to the config file
